h: לְרֹאשׁ חֹדֶשׁ מְנַחֵם אָב, א׳ Rosh Chodesh Menachem Av, 1

p: It is stated in the Gemara (Pesachim 77a)
that Rosh Chodesh is called a "mo'ed,"
"He proclaimed a mo'ed against me," etc.
And we do not find anywhere
that Rosh Chodesh is called a mo'ed
and from it we derive (Pesachim ibid.)
that the goat-offerings of Rosh Chodesh
are brought even in a state of tumah,
for we expound "in its appointed time"—
אֲשֶׁר אִוָּעֵד לָכֶם שָׁמָּה (שְׁמוֹת כט, מב)
there was the resting of the Shechinah.
"Who dwells with them amid their tumah,"
וְכֵן הוּא בְּכָל יְמֵי חַג וּמוֹעֵד
And so it is on all the days of festival and mo'ed.
we do not find in the Torah
that it is called a "mikra kodesh";
רַק בִּלְשׁוֹן חֲזַ״ל מָצִינוּ (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה כד, א)
only in the language of Chazal do we find (Rosh Hashanah 24a)
that at the sanctification of the month
the head of the beis din says "Mekudash,"
and all the people respond after him,
the holiness within it is still hidden and concealed
when the light of the sun will be sevenfold,
כְּאוֹר שִׁבְעַת הַיָּמִים (רְאֵה יְשַׁעְיָה ל, כו)
as the light of the seven days (see Yeshayah 30:26),
as it was at the time of Creation
and the moon will receive the light from the sun.
From this the Sages had an illumination
דְּרֹאשׁ חוֹדֶשׁ יֵשׁ בּוֹ גַּם כֵּן קְדוּשָּׁה
that Rosh Chodesh, too, has holiness in it
And this is rooted chiefly in this month,
for it is stated in Sefer Yetzirah:
"He made the letter Tes king over hearing," etc.,
One who sees a Tes in his dream,
it is a good sign for him, etc.,
הוֹאִיל וּפָתַח בּוֹ הַכָּתוּב לְטוֹבָה תְּחִלָּה
since Scripture opened with it for good at the very first;
And this month was created with the letter Tes,
which denotes "the light, that it was good,"
it was outwardly the very opposite,
for in it both Batei Mikdash were destroyed,
which are called "the light of the world,"
"Let him go and occupy himself with the light of the world,"
as it is written, "And they shall stream to it," etc.
But it is according to what
is written in the holy Zohar (Introduction 3a)
מָה רַב טוּבְךָ אֲשֶׁר צָפַנְתָּ וְגוֹמֵר
'How great is Your goodness that You have hidden,' etc."
And this is only in this world,
עַל יְדֵי דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
through David HaMelech, peace be upon him,
who is a chariot for the attribute of Malchus,
and of whom it is written (Tehillim 21:5):
and the letter Tes denotes life
therefore in the city of Luz,
the Angel of Death has no dominion over it;
then there will be no night,
for "the light of the moon will be as the light of the sun,"
and it will be like day in this world,
and this light will be renewed every month;
and then the holiness of the month will be revealed,
that it too is called a mo'ed.
"Rosh Chodesh, which is called a mo'ed—let one say it?
It is not sanctified by a prohibition of labor," etc.,
for a day that is not sanctified as a festival
חֲזִינְהוּ דְּקָא קָרוּ הַלֵּילָא בְּרֵישׁ יַרְחָא
he saw them reciting Hallel on Rosh Chodesh,
When he saw that they were skipping portions,
that it is a custom of their fathers in their hands.
This implies that this custom originated in Bavel,
and Rav, who came from Eretz Yisrael—
there they did not have the custom
of saying Hallel on Rosh Chodesh.
That is, they did not perceive
דְּרֹאשׁ חוֹדֶשׁ יֵשׁ בּוֹ מִקְּדוּשַּׁת מוֹעֵד
that Rosh Chodesh has in it some of the holiness of a mo'ed,
until they came to Bavel after the Churban,
אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי חוֹשֵׁב עֲלֵיכֶם נְאוּם ה׳
that I think concerning you, says Hashem—
thoughts of peace and not of evil,
to give you a future and hope."
that on Tishah B'Av Mashiach was born.
there is born on Tishah B'Av
Just as at the time of Creation,
Adam HaRishon was born on the sixth day,
while concerning the spirit of Mashiach
this is the spirit of Mashiach."
And this is "Behind and before You formed me":
he was created on the sixth day,
וְרוּחוֹ שֶׁל מָשִׁיחַ עוֹד בְּיוֹם רִאשׁוֹן
and the spirit of Mashiach already on the first day,
for it is written then (Bereishis ibid.):
"And the earth was formless and void,
and darkness upon the face of the deep," etc.;
that is, "He made darkness His hiding place,"
which is the intellect hidden from all thought,
and it precedes the work of Creation.
And in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 11b)
it counted "Let there be light" as the first utterance;
that is, even in the utterance "Let there be light"
there is still no grasp at all,
it says, "'Bereishis' is also an utterance,"
and the utterance "Let there be light"
is counted as the second utterance;
that is, in the utterance "Let there be light"
כְּבָר יֵשׁ בּוֹ אֵיזֶה תְּפִיסָה קְצָת
there is already some slight grasp,
for the five times "light" is written
correspond to the five Chumashim of the Torah,
and in this there is a grasp;
is intellect hidden from all thought.
And in it the spirit of Mashiach is mentioned,
and he is born on every Tishah B'Av.
Right on the day of the Churban,
when they were conquered in the morning,
at once a thought of teshuvah arose in their hearts;
from this the aspect of Mashiach was born,
as they said in the Midrash there,
that had they been so in Eretz Yisrael
they would not have needed to go into exile
(as they said in the Pesikta Rabbasi, Piska 26).
לֹא עָלָה עַל דַּעְתָּם שֶׁיֵּחָרֵב הַבַּיִת
it did not occur to them that the House would be destroyed,
for they held, "Hashem is with us."
Afterwards, when they saw that they had been conquered,
they contemplated teshuvah in their hearts,
and from this Mashiach was born;
"'Hovering over the face of the waters'—
For they were already fit for redemption,
אִם הָיָה הַתְּשׁוּבָה כְּתִיקּוּנָהּ מִכֹּל וָכֹל
had the teshuvah been entirely as it should be,
"Today, if you will listen to His voice,"
for it overrides a prohibition of the Torah,
"and you have strayed with many lovers—
it is forbidden to take her back.
And it is stated (Vayikra Rabbah, Bechukosai 35:3):
"A being of flesh and blood issues a decree," etc.,
"but the Holy One, blessed be He,
is not so; rather, He issues a decree
and fulfills it first Himself," etc.
that there was no sin at all.
He said: Master of the world,
they have made You a helper, etc.:
and it makes the plants grow.
The Holy One, blessed be He, said:
Moshe, are you too mistaken like them?
Is there not nothing to it?
אִם כֵּן לָמָּה אַתָּה כּוֹעֵס עַל בָּנֶיךָ וְכוּלֵּי
If so, why are You angry with Your children? etc.
A parable: a king entered his house
and found his wife embracing a wooden stand;
his groomsman said to him," etc.
And in the future, after the clarification,
that there never was at all
a "you have strayed with many lovers."
So it is according to the Midrash.
From the Baal Shem Tov, zy"a,
אִיתָא (רְאֵה כֶּתֶר שֵׁם טוֹב אוֹת רצז)
it is related (see Kesser Shem Tov, 297)
a parable of one who came to test his wife:
he disguised himself before her as a ship's captain,
seized her and tried to seduce her,
until he forced her to yield to him.
and revealed the matter to him.
and you never strayed with another.
כֵּן יְבָרֵר ה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ חֲטָאֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
So will Hashem Yisbarach clarify the sins of Yisrael,
שֶׁהַכֹּל הָיָה עַל פִּי ה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ
that everything was by the word of Hashem Yisbarach.
And so I heard from my master and teacher of Izhbitz, zt"l,
that Hashem Yisbarach will make clear
and from Him the matters came forth,
after they do teshuvah out of love,
through which willful sins become like merits.
That is, Hashem Yisbarach will make clear:
"If your sins be like the years,"
like these years that come in fixed order
from the six days of Creation
That is, such is the order of Creation:
except that which comes forth from within darkness.
And this is "hovering over the face of the waters"—
in the merit of teshuvah, which is likened to water,
as it says, "Pour out your heart like water."
And water is the aspect of chessed and love,
means that it is out of love;
of which it is stated in the Pesikta (Pesikta d'Rav Kahana 13:15)
that in it the Beis HaMikdash will be built—
even though it appears that in it was extinguished
in it the Beis HaMikdash will be built;
(סוּכָּה מא, א דִּבּוּר הַמַּתְחִיל אִי נַמִּי)
that since it will be built by the hands of Heaven
Therefore it was created with the letter Tes,
which denotes "light, that it was good,"
and "the light of the tzaddikim will rejoice."
אַף שֶׁבְּחוֹדֶשׁ זֶה אָסוּר כָּל שִׂמְחָה
Yet in this month all joy is forbidden,
so what is this expression, "we diminish in joy"?
Is not even a little of it a problem?
its goodness is hidden within it, as said above,
and in the future it will become clear
שֶׁהַכֹּל הָיָה בְּחִינַת אוֹר כִּי טוֹב
that all of it was the aspect of "light, that it was good."
hidden and concealed in the heart;
that in the future the day of Tishah B'Av will be transformed
and there will be joy on it.
Therefore in Bavel they perceived then,
on this Rosh Chodesh, that it is called a mo'ed,
and it was a custom of their fathers in their hands
for there is still no grasp of it,
"It is not sanctified by a prohibition of labor,"
for it is not sanctified as a festival
and labor is not forbidden on it;
and even the Sages did not forbid labor on it.
"where you hid on the day of work,"
and Targum Yonasan renders "on the weekday";
is not called "the day of work."
וְכֵן מָצִינוּ בְּשָׁאוּל הַמֶּלֶךְ (שְׁמוּאֵל א שָׁם, ה-כז)
And so we find with Shaul HaMelech (Shmuel I ibid., 5–27)
that he made a Rosh Chodesh feast;
for concerning the king it is stated in Sefer Yetzirah (Chapter 6):
"The heart in the soul is like a king in battle";
for all of Yisrael are one complete stature,
and the king corresponds to the heart;
and made a Rosh Chodesh feast.
who is likened to the moon,
and this will be revealed only in the future.
And so it is stated in the writings of the Arizal
(פְּרִי עֵץ חַיִּים שַׁעַר רֹאשׁ חֹדֶשׁ ג)
that he listed twelve permutations of the Name Havayah
corresponding to the twelve months of the year.
The permutation of the month of Nissan
is the Name in its order,
which emerges from the initial letters of the pasuk
יִשְׂמְחוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וְתָגֵל הָאָרֶץ (תְּהִלִּים צו, יא)
"Let the heavens rejoice and the earth exult" (Tehillim 96:11),
since then the nation of Yisrael was revealed.
And the permutation of the month of Menachem Av
(מַאַמְרֵי תַּמּוּז אָב מַאֲמָר א אוֹת ט)
מִפְּנֵי מָה כְּשֶׁאָנוּ רוֹצִין לְהַזְכִּיר הַשֵּׁם
why, when we wish to mention the Name,
we call it by the name "Havayah"
But in truth the reason is simple:
just like the Name in its order.
and likewise, "even at the time of her niddah,
there can be havayah with her" (ibid. 68a);
And this is the connection of this permutation
כִּי בֶּאֱמֶת הַשֵּׁם הַזֶּה הוּא בְּהֶעְלֵם
for in truth this Name is concealed,
For in truth, in this month,
it is in great concealment and hiddenness,
the light of Mashiach was created,
in the merit of teshuvah out of love,
which is likened to water, as said above;
and then it will become clear
that Yisrael have havayah and marriage—
"and return to Me, says Hashem" (Yirmiyah ibid.).
And so the occupation of this month:
the main thing is that a person be able
to be aroused to teshuvah out of love,
since in it was created and born
as it is written, "And the spirit of Elokim hovered
over the face of the waters," as said above.
And then, "in the place where baalei teshuvah stand,
that this disagrees with Rabbi Abahu,
when one does teshuvah out of love
and willful sins become like merits,
the completely righteous do not stand there,
do not have merits like these,
when "If your sins be," etc., becomes clear;
except that which comes forth from within darkness,
it will be "very good," as said above.
